values.note: Book online on Campspot or call 231-869-5811. Campspot refuses a single night on every date read, weekdays included ('There is a 2 night minimum over the requested period of time', 2027-06-15 Tuesday; May-October 2027 on 2026-10-13); the rates page names a 2-night weekend minimum and 3 nights for Memorial Day, the 4th of July, Labor Day and Pentwater's Homecoming Festival in August. Weekend and holiday stays are paid in full at booking (from 2027, every reservation under 14 days); cancel 7+ days out less a $50 fee.

booking.source: https://hillandhollowcampground.com/rates/ ('Call 231-869-5811 for reservations or book with us online'; 'Weekend (min. 2 nights)'; 'Holidays (min. 3 nights)'; '3-night minimum for all legal holidays (Memorial Day, 4th of July, Labor Day) and Pentwater's Homecoming Festival in August'; '*Beginning in 2027, full payment is required for reservations under 14 days*'; cancellation) + https://www.campspot.com/book/hillandhollowcampground (RESERVATION_MIN_RULE on every RV type for 1 night from 2027-06-15), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 'More than 200' sites. About 130 RV sites are sold on Campspot in ten types; only the Vintage (to 32 ft), Vintage Full Hook-Up 30 Amp (32 ft) and Deluxe Full Hook-Up (45 ft) types list a Class C motorhome. Premium Pull Thru sites to 46 ft.

sites.source: https://hillandhollowcampground.com/ ('More than 200 Amazing Campsites') + https://www.campspot.com/book/hillandhollowcampground (site types and longest rig: Premium Pull Thru 46 ft; rig types per site type from the park record in audit/price_research/campspot_tier_2026-10-13.jsonl), read 2026-10-22

summary: Operator rates page (c. 2026) + its Campspot engine (/book/hillandhollowcampground, read 2026-10-22): weekday $65 W/E / $70 full hookup, weekend $65/$75, holiday $73.33/$80, quiet season $45 (before Memorial Day, after Labor Day), plus the park's $10 booking fee per stay; June 2027 on Campspot $65-70 site rate weekdays, Sept 2027 $45 - all as already recorded, fees left. 2-night minimum on every date (weekdays too) confirmed; added the 3-night holiday minimum and the /book/ url. Confirmed 50 A full hookups, 200+ sites, pull-throughs; max_rig 46 ft added. Phone 231-869-5811 matches. Seasonal campers are present but ~130 RV sites are sold nightly online: not seasonal in character. Nearest gateway: none within 40 km (Grand Rapids 112 km); the family has not stayed here. Note unchanged.
flags: Price gate (private, US$50): in season (Memorial Day to Labor Day) the cheapest site a 23-ft Class C may book is $65 a night (Vintage / Water-Electric, weekdays and weekends; $73.33 holidays), over US$50; only the quiet-season rate ($45, before Memorial Day weekend and after Labor Day weekend) is under. No gateway within 40 km (Grand Rapids 112 km, Sleeping Bear Dunes 115 km); the family has not stayed here. Source: https://hillandhollowcampground.com/rates/ + Campspot 2027-06-15 quote.

Website: the entry links the Campspot marketplace page https://www.campspot.com/park/hill-and-hollow-campground-pentwater-mi; the operator's own 'Reserve a Campsite' link is the booking engine https://www.campspot.com/book/hillandhollowcampground (now in booking.url). The operator site answers on https://hillandhollowcampground.com/.

Rig-type restriction: on Campspot only three site types list a Class C motorhome (Vintage to 32 ft, Vintage Full Hook-Up 30 Amp, Deluxe Full Hook-Up); the Water/Electric type lists Class B only and the Premium types Class A only.
